name: codebase-dna-guardian
description: Extracts and enforces a codebase's tribal knowledge — naming conventions, architectural patterns, error handling strategies, import styles, and dependency choices. Generates a DNA profile and acts as a passive guardian when writing new code.

commands.name: dna-scan
commands.description: Scan the codebase and extract conventions as a DNA profile. Samples ~15-20 representative files and writes .claude/dna.md (or .claude/dna/ for monorepos).

commands.name: dna-check
commands.description: Audit a file or directory against the DNA profile. Reports HARD/SOFT violations with line-level locations.

commands.name: dna-refactor
commands.description: Auto-fix convention violations in a file or directory. Always shows a plan before applying changes.

commands.name: dna-report
commands.description: Generate a project-wide health dashboard with consistency score, violations, zombie dependencies, and architectural drift zones.

commands.name: dna-preview
commands.description: Render an interactive HTML visual report. Serves locally and opens in browser (or takes a screenshot in headless mode).

commands.name: dna-onboard
commands.description: Generate a concise new-developer briefing from the DNA profile.

commands.name: dna-diff
commands.description: Compare current codebase against the existing DNA profile to detect convention evolution.

commands.name: dna-guard
commands.description: Pre-merge gate — checks a branch's changes against DNA and blocks merges with HARD violations.

passive_triggers.condition: File .claude/dna.md or .claude/dna/ directory exists in the project
passive_triggers.behavior: Silently read DNA before generating any new code. Apply PREF rules silently, SOFT rules with footnote, HARD violations stop generation.

dashboard.description: Interactive visual report with score ring, per-service bars, rules browser, zombie tracker, and evolution sparkline.
